name: 007 ELEMENTS
kurzbeschreibung: The globally unique cinematic James Bond installation 007 ELEMENTS perches at 3,048 meters above sea level on the summit of Gaislachkogl in Sölden.
preis: Exhibition ticket adults from approx. €26.00; combined ticket including cable car from approx. €64.00
oeffnungszeiten: Daily during cable car operation (summer June–October, winter December–April) from 09:00 to 16:30
beschreibung:
Overview

The spectacular James Bond experience installation 007 ELEMENTS sits at an altitude of 3,048 meters directly on the summit of Gaislachkogl in the rear Ötztal above Sölden. This globally unique cinematic installation is entirely dedicated to the world of the famous secret agent and was built on the original filming location where key scenes for the blockbuster movie "Spectre" were shot. Designed by Tyrolean architect Johann Obermoser, the visionary structure was built inside the rocky ridge of the three-thousand-meter peak and features minimalist concrete cubes that blend seamlessly with the alpine rock landscape. Visitors enter through nine underground galleries into an atmospheric film world of futuristic architecture, original film props, state-of-the-art sound technology, and interactive experience stations with expansive panoramic views of the Stubai and Ötztal glaciers.

Route & Requirements

Access to the exhibition is straightforward and barrier-free via two sections of the modern Gaislachkoglbahn I and II cable car from Sölden. Inside the exhibition galleries, permafrost conditions are maintained for conservation reasons, keeping temperatures around freezing point; wearing warm winter clothing, a warm jacket, and sturdy shoes is strongly recommended even in midsummer. The underground galleries are fully accessible via wide ramps and corridors, allowing families with strollers and visitors with reduced mobility to explore comfortably. As the facility is situated above 3,000 meters, visitors should allow time for slow acclimatization. Directly adjacent to the exhibition stands the architecturally acclaimed gourmet restaurant ice Q with its suspension bridge.

Visit & Arrival

007 ELEMENTS is open daily during summer and winter seasons parallel to Gaislachkoglbahn operating hours (summer June to October, winter December to April). Tickets are available online or at ticket counters; combined tickets including the cable car ride are recommended. Motorists reach Sölden toll-free from Germany via the A7 and Fernpass or via the Inntal motorway A12 (exit Ötztal), following the B186 into the valley to the valley station. Rail travelers arrive at Ötztal Bahnhof and take frequent VVT bus route 4194 directly to the Sölden Gaislachkoglbahn stop.

Tips

Book your entry time slots online in advance to avoid waiting times at the summit. After the tour, indulge in a gourmet lunch or a martini at ice Q restaurant and step onto the glass viewing platform overlooking the dramatic alpine abyss.
